owner_calls.question: Keep this tie? Mina is one of the many people across New Orleans pulled into Andre's trance club. No scene shows the two dealing with each other one on one. It is his power acting on her directly, but it is also a mass event.
options: Keep as is (Andre's trance acts on Mina directly)
Drop (a mass event where they never deal with each other)
owner_calls.evidence: Cloak & Dagger S2E10 'Level Up': people disappear all over the city into Andre's trance, Mina among them. Tandy and Tyrone defeat Andre and free everyone.

owner_calls.question: Does the show say on screen that Karnak and Gorgon are cousins? Sources only describe each one as Black Bolt's cousin (and Triton as Karnak's brother). If the show never makes them cousins of each other, the kind 'family' and the card lines 'Karnak's cousin' / 'Gorgon's cousin' rest on the comics.
options: Change kind to friend and drop the 'cousin' wording
owner_calls.evidence: Inhumans cast list: Karnak is 'Black Bolt's cousin and closest adviser'; Gorgon is 'Black Bolt's cousin and leader of Attilan's Royal Guard'. Episode summaries (eps 5 to 8) support the rest of the text: Gorgon rescues Karnak and Jen, dies in ep 6, and is revived by a second Terrigenesis in ep 7.

owner_calls.question: This is outside the stage I checked (stage 0 passes), but stage 1 has a factual title error. Stage 1 sits on #37 ('Venom Returns'), yet its text also says Mordo helps turn Cletus Kasady into Carnage, and that happens in #38 ('Carnage'). Move stage 1 to 'Spider-Man (1994)#38'?
owner_calls.evidence: Ep 37 'Venom Returns': Dormammu and Mordo bring the symbiote back to Earth. Ep 38 'Carnage': when Brock refuses them, they turn Cletus Kasady into Carnage.
